mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level (indicating an accommodative monetary policy) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (exceeding 0.3 percentage points over three months) signals deteriorating labor market conditions and economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when UNRATE rises >0.3pp in 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales (indicating weak consumer demand) trigger a negative feedback loop in the economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an impending slowdown in the real economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of instances during late-cycle expansions when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when RSAFS is above its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the consumer price index (exceeding 0.2 percentage points over three months) signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises >0.2pp in 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and increases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate a rapidly deteriorating labor market, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, an increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals aggressive policy action, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of instances during monetary tightening cycles when FEDFUNDS rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
